subject: Quick info question
text: Hey there, quick favor! We're tweaking the client portal tomorrow morning, so any info we need from you has to land by 3 pm today. Can you shoot over the current support hours and the refund policy? I want to make sure the new service page tells the right thing. Also, do you know if the chatbot can handle billing questions yet? We don't want anyone bounced around. Let me know ASAP so we can tweak the copy. It would be a huge help. If it's easier, I can call you before lunch. We'll be fine once it's in. Really appreciate! Cheers,
